title: Money can't buy happiness, but…
summary: One short clip with "Money can't buy happiness, but it can buy…" and the small treat that really lifts your mood. AI helps you write the lines.
why: An Instagram Reels trends roundup updated October 23, 2026 lists "Money can't buy happiness but…" as a trend from October 16: one clip of about seven seconds with a few lines of text showing what a small purchase does for your mood.
steps: Film about seven seconds of a small thing that makes you happy: a warm drink, fresh flowers, new socks.
Use the main prompt to get a few short text lines that fit the clip.
Add "Money can't buy happiness, but…" first, then your line underneath.
Keep it to one clip and post with a sound from the app.

prompts.label: Main prompt
prompts.text: Write 8 options for on-screen text that starts "Money can't buy happiness, but it can buy…". My clip shows [what's in your clip]. Each ending is under 10 words and about a small, everyday joy, not luxury. Make a few funny and a few cosy. Use Canadian spelling. No hashtags.

prompts.label: Variation: fall edition
prompts.text: Write 8 endings for "Money can't buy happiness, but it can buy…" about small fall treats in Canada, like a hot drink on a cold morning, a new toque, a pumpkin from the farm stand or a cosy candle. Each ending under 10 words, warm and a little funny.

prompts.label: Variation: small business
prompts.text: I run [your type of business] and sell [your product or service]. Write 6 endings for "Money can't buy happiness, but it can buy…" that show the small, honest mood boost my customers get, like [one real example]. Each ending under 10 words. Friendly, not pushy. Don't make up prices, reviews, results or deadlines.

tips: Small and real wins. A good coffee is more relatable than a fancy purchase.
Show the moment of joy in the clip, like the first sip or the box opening.
Seven seconds is enough. Give the text time to be read.
For business posts, only promise what your product really does.
